text:
anya (pm): Opening a tight thread for the safety-first phased rollout of the new routing + quantized path. Need an actionable plan we can run this quarter. Quick proposal below, keep replies short.

anya (pm): Short plan:
- internal-dark: mirror 0.5% traffic for 12h (no responses).
- opt-in-canary: up to 10 tenants, max 0.5% live traffic, 1:1 A/B, 4h bake.
- scale-canary: up to 50 tenants, 5% live, 70/30 split, 24h observation.
- regional-slice: enable EU/US/APAC slices 10% each, respect SLA tiers.
- soft-launch: 50% token budget cap then GA after 7 days.

leila (sre): Circuit breaker rules: p95 > 2x baseline for 10m OR error rate delta > 0.4% for 5m -> auto-divert tenant. Region auto-divert requires 3 tenants tripping within 15m. Manual unblock only. Also add warmup throttle: default 20 rps/tenant during warmup.

rob (eng): Flag schema must include: min_sample, min_time_mins, warmup_rps, dry_warm boolean, owner. Need API to flip flags + reason codes. Will add rollout controller to enforce min_sample before increasing percent.

diego (data): Metric groups: fidelity (embed cosine, rerank swap), infra (p50/p95, errors), and business (CTR/engagement). For small cohorts use bootstrap CI and require sustained signal for 6h before scale. Baseline window 48h, test window 24h.

zoe (cs): For customers: opt-in consent + per-tenant toggle in console. Add an "auto-divert preference" field for customers who want manual review before divert. Drafting FAQ.

anya (pm): Example minimal flag payload we want in infra: {"name":"ff.region.eu.optin.quant","default":false,"allowed_tenants":["acct_alpha"],"min_sample":"200","min_time_mins":"60","warmup_rps":"20","dry_warm":"true","owner":"anya"} (keep as string in the doc).

rob (eng): We'll implement dry_warm to hit a non-billing warm path for cache priming. Also adding smoke traffic generator to validate stratified sampling.

leila (sre): Add oncall playbook snippet: if auto-divert fires page SRE, tag incident with "auto-divert" and run quick triage. Postmortem only if human unblocked.

diego (data): A/B analysis: stratify by tenant size and prompt length; use permutation tests and report effect sizes. Auto-alert if effect size > 0.02 on core metric.

flag-service-bot: Created flag ff.region.eu.optin.quant in staging at 1866664321.

anya (pm): Actions: rob - flag API + controller (ETA Thu). diego - gating doc + dashboard panels (ETA Wed). leila - circuit breaker + warmup throttle (ETA Fri). zoe - CS opt-in flow + FAQ (ETA Mon). I'll schedule internal-dark next Tue. Ack here.

rob (eng): ack.

leila (sre): ack.

diego (data): ack.

zoe (cs): ack, drafting comms.

anya (pm): If no objections by EOD I'll merge the flag PR and book the test window. Thanks.
